name: Citi® / AAdvantage® Platinum Select® World Elite Mastercard®

travelAccidentInsurance.notes: Travel Accident Insurance up to $250,000 when traveling as a passenger on a common carrier. Must purchase ticket with card.

emergencyMedical.notes: No dedicated emergency medical or evacuation benefit. Citi Concierge can assist with referrals.

rentalCarInsurance.notes: Auto rental insurance — secondary coverage. File with personal auto insurance first. Must decline rental company CDW.

purchaseProtection.notes: Purchase protection not a standard benefit on this card. Verify current terms.

extendedWarranty.notes: Extended Warranty: doubles the warranty period up to 2 additional years on eligible items.

annualCredits.name: Companion Certificate
annualCredits.notes: Earn a $99 companion certificate for a domestic round-trip Main Cabin ticket after spending $20,000 in purchases per calendar year and card renewal. Just pay taxes and fees.

freeCheckedBags.notes: First checked bag free for cardholder and up to 4 companions on the same reservation when flying American Airlines. Saves $35 per person each way.

priorityBoarding.notes: Preferred boarding in Group 5 on American Airlines — before general boarding.

inflight.notes: 25% savings on in-flight food and beverage purchases on American Airlines flights.

eliteStatusBenefits.notes: Earn Loyalty Points on every purchase — helps qualify for AAdvantage elite status tiers (Gold=40K, Platinum=75K, Platinum Pro=125K, Executive Platinum=200K Loyalty Points).

travelPerks: First checked bag free (cardholder + up to 4 companions)
Group 5 preferred boarding on American Airlines
25% in-flight food and beverage savings (as statement credit)
2x miles on American Airlines, dining, and grocery stores
$99 companion certificate (after $20,000 annual spend at renewal)
Extended warranty (doubles manufacturer warranty up to 2 years)
bestFor: American Airlines loyalists who want free checked bags and preferred boarding at an affordable annual fee
